title: Implement PixelShuffle and its inverse
prompt: Implement PixelShuffle, or its inverse PixelUnshuffle, by reshape/permutation only. Input is BCHW; reject invalid divisibility. Forward maps [B,C*r*r,H,W] to [B,C,H*r,W*r].

resources.title: PixelShuffle (PyTorch docs)
resources.why: Defines the channel-to-space rearrangement used by sub-pixel convolution upsamplers.
